title: Impact Matters! An Audit Method to Evaluate AI Projects and their Impact for Sustainability and Public Interest
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not present a benchmark and does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It proposes a qualitative audit method for AI projects based on sustainability and public interest.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
